blurb.gen9lc: Little Cup: level 5, first stages only. Bring your own team: a saved one, or paste one in Showdown's export format.
blurb.gen9monotype: Every Pokémon shares a type; no Tera. Bring your own team: a saved one, or paste one in Showdown's export format.
blurb.gen9nationaldex: Every Pokémon, Megas and Z-Moves; no Tera. Bring your own team: a saved one, or paste one in Showdown's export format.
blurb.gen9triples: Three Pokémon out a side; single-target moves reach only adjacent Pokémon, and an edge Pokémon can shift to the centre. Bring your own team: a saved one, or paste one in Showdown's export format.
blurb.gen9freeforallrandombattle: Four trainers, each on their own, one Pokémon out each. Last trainer standing wins. Random teams.
blurb.gen9multirandombattle: Two against two: you and a partner share a side, three random Pokémon each, one out each.
blurb.gen9freeforall: Four trainers, each on their own, one Pokémon out each. Bring your own team: a saved one, or paste one in Showdown's export format.
blurb.custom: Your own ruleset: any generation's mechanics, level, gimmicks, clauses and team size.

blurb.bssfactory: Rental teams from Showdown's Battle Stadium sets: level 50, bring six, pick three.
blurb.tower: Flat Rules: level 50, bring six, pick three; Species, Item and Nickname Clauses.
blurb.gen9randombattle: Six random Pokémon each, with sets built for them. No team needed.
blurb.gen9randomdoublesbattle: Two Pokémon out at a time, random teams. Pick a target for each move.
